description: Source code for radio delay management, including timer initialization, start, stop, and callback functions for handling delay up events in a radio management system.

methods.name: s_apDelayUpDone_cb
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the delay timer expires, calls wld_rad_delayMgr_apDelayUpDone.

methods.name: wld_rad_delayMgr_init
methods.description: Initializes the delay manager timer for a radio object.

methods.name: wld_rad_delayMgr_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the delay manager timer for a radio object.

methods.name: wld_rad_delayMgr_startApDelayUp
methods.description: Starts the delay timer for the radio to transition to delay up state.

methods.name: wld_rad_delayMgr_apDelayUpDone
methods.description: Handles completion of the delay up timer, transitions state, and notifies upper layers.

methods.name: _Radio_apDelayUpDone
methods.description: External interface function to trigger delay up completion handling.

methods.name: wld_rad_delayMgr_setDelayApUpPeriod_pwf
methods.description: Sets the delay period for the delay up timer.
